_comment: Edit this file to point the skill at a different scope, cadence, or delivery target. Nothing in the skill or workflow files should need to change for a new deployment - if it does, that's a bug in the skill, not a config gap.

scope._note: When mode is 'regions', include_regions holds country names, region names, or IATA/ICAO codes and discovery is restricted to them. Empty include_regions with mode 'global' means no restriction. exclude_regions applies in either mode.

cadence._note: Targets for the two-cadence architecture (build-plan Batch 1). The single combined workflow that exists today runs on whatever cadence its Routine trigger is set to; these values are the intended settings once the flash/deep split lands.

dashboard._note: auto_refresh means the dashboard is regenerated and republished as the last step of every successful cycle, once that step exists (build-plan Batch 4). There is no in-page 'run now' control - a published Artifact cannot trigger a skill run; see the operating plan, section 9.

email._note: Disabled until a Gmail/Outlook connector is authorized on this org and the digest formatter (build-plan Batch 5) exists. digest_style is a hint to the digest-rendering step to include a supply-chain-relevant visual, not a raw text dump.

feature_flags._note: flight_tracking_api requires an actual provider account and API key (build-plan Batch 3) before it can be turned on. verification_pass gates the thin-sourced/high-impact re-check step (build-plan Batch 2).

budgets._note: max_tokens_per_cycle_hint is informational context for whoever is sizing cadence/scope, not an enforced runtime cap - the workflow script has no way to abort mid-run on token spend today.
